display.purpose: Hero headline only, one per page.

title.purpose: Product names, card titles, form section headers.

label.purpose: Nav, buttons, meta text — uppercase, wide tracking.

shadows.name: hover-lift
shadows.purpose: Product image hover, open dropdowns/drawers only. Never at rest.

shadows.name: modal-scrim
shadows.purpose: Quick-view modal, cart drawer, size-chart modal.

motion.name: ease-out-quart
motion.purpose: Default easing for hover, reveal, and drawer transitions. No bounce/elastic.

motion.name: duration-standard
motion.purpose: Image reveals, drawer/modal open, scroll reveals.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single primary action per section — Shop Collection, Add to Cart, Book a Consultation.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: oklch(0.220 0.010 55); color: oklch(0.970 0.012 75); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 18px 44px; border: none; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background 180ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.160 0.008 45); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.970 0.012 75); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Fallback action beside a primary button — Explore New Arrivals, View Details.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: oklch(0.220 0.010 55); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 17px 42px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.220 0.010 55); border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background 180ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: oklch(0.220 0.010 55); color: oklch(0.970 0.012 75); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.220 0.010 55); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Customizable Badge
components.description: The one badge that breaks from charcoal — marks products eligible for custom measurements/design.
components.css: .ds-badge-customizable { display: inline-block; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.480 0.095 16); border: 1px solid oklch(0.480 0.095 16); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 5px 11px; border-radius: 0; }

narrative.overview: Aval Designs should feel like stepping into a quiet, sunlit atelier the week before a wedding — not a shopping cart. The palette is warm and restrained (ivory, beige, charcoal) so that fashion photography and the promise of a garment made to fit you carry the emotional weight, with muted rose and soft gold appearing only where the brand wants to be noticed: a button, a divider, a customization badge. Structure alternates between light editorial pages (ivory) and deep espresso-charcoal sections (footer, the Create Your Design CTA, editorial banners) — never a fully dark site, but enough contrast to keep the page from reading as one long cream scroll, which is the single biggest way a boutique site collapses into generic template territory.
keyCharacteristics: Ivory/beige neutrals do the structural work; rose and gold are named, deliberate accents, not a wash of warm applied everywhere.
Deep espresso-charcoal sections punctuate the page for rhythm and to avoid an all-cream, low-contrast feel.
Square-cornered, editorial-grid layouts; no card-soup, no icon clutter.
Large, consistent-ratio photography is the primary visual language — UI chrome stays quiet.

rules.name: The Two-Accent Rule
rules.body: Only rose and gold ever act as color accents. No third hue enters the palette anywhere.

rules.name: The Restraint Rule
rules.body: Rose and gold combined never cover more than ~10% of any given viewport.

rules.name: The Punctuation Rule
rules.body: No more than two consecutive ivory sections before an espresso (or ivory-deep) section breaks the rhythm.

rules.name: The One-Serif Rule
rules.body: Playfair Display appears only at Display and Headline scale; body/UI text is always Inter.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: No card, product tile, or panel carries a shadow in its default state; shadows are exclusively a response to hover, open, or focus.

dos: Do keep corners square (0px) everywhere — buttons, cards, inputs, badges, images.
Do let photography be the largest element on any given section.
Do alternate Ivory / Ivory-Deep / Espresso section backgrounds to create editorial rhythm.
Do reserve Rose and Gold for specific, named roles — never as general decoration.
Do use Playfair Display only at Display/Headline scale; everything else is Inter.
donts: Don't use overly colorful UI, gradients, or neon/bright accents anywhere in the system.
Don't use cheap-looking or heavy drop shadows, or any shadow present at an element's resting state.
Don't build cluttered, dense layouts or over-animate.
Don't crop or shrink product photography.
Don't introduce a third accent hue anywhere.
